name: Publish System Requirements

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'rules/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Test rules
        run: |
          npm install
          npm test

      - name: Create rules bundle
        run: |
          GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          echo "Git SHA: ${GIT_SHA}"

          # Create staging directory
          STAGING_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
          BUNDLE_DIR="${STAGING_DIR}/rstudio-sysreqs-rules"
          mkdir -p "${BUNDLE_DIR}"

          # Copy rules, scripts, and license
          cp -r rules/* "${BUNDLE_DIR}/"
          if [ -d scripts ]; then
            mkdir -p "${BUNDLE_DIR}/scripts"
            cp -r scripts/* "${BUNDLE_DIR}/scripts/" 2>/dev/null || true
          fi
          cp LICENSE "${BUNDLE_DIR}/LICENSE"

          # Add git SHA marker inside the archive
          echo "${GIT_SHA}" > "${BUNDLE_DIR}/latest_git_sha.txt"

          # Create tar archive
          tar -czvf /tmp/sysreqs.tar.gz -C "${STAGING_DIR}" rstudio-sysreqs-rules

          # Generate checksum
          CHECKSUM=$(md5sum /tmp/sysreqs.tar.gz | cut -c -32)
          echo "${GIT_SHA}" > /tmp/latest_git_sha.txt
          echo "${CHECKSUM}" > /tmp/latest_checksum.txt

          echo "Bundle created: $(ls -lh /tmp/sysreqs.tar.gz)"
          echo "Checksum: ${CHECKSUM}"
          echo "Git SHA: ${GIT_SHA}"

          # Expose for later smoke test.
          echo "GIT_SHA=${GIT_SHA}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "CHECKSUM=${CHECKSUM}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

        if: ${{ inputs.dry_run != true }}
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v6
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

        if: ${{ inputs.dry_run != true }}
        run: |
          aws s3 cp /tmp/sysreqs.tar.gz "s3://${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${{ env.S3_PREFIX }}/latest.tar.gz"
          aws s3 cp /tmp/latest_git_sha.txt "s3://${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${{ env.S3_PREFIX }}/latest_git_sha.txt"
          aws s3 cp /tmp/latest_checksum.txt "s3://${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${{ env.S3_PREFIX }}/latest_checksum.txt"
          echo "Uploaded sysreqs to s3://${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}/${{ env.S3_PREFIX }}/"

      - name: Invalidate CloudFront
        if: ${{ inputs.dry_run != true }}
        env:
          AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS: "5"
          AWS_RETRY_MODE: adaptive
        run: |
          INV_ID=$(aws cloudfront create-invalidation \
            --distribution-id "${{ secrets.CLOUDFRONT_DISTRIBUTION_ID }}" \
            --paths '/sysreqs/*' \
            --query 'Invalidation.Id' --output text)
          echo "Invalidation ID: ${INV_ID}"
          aws cloudfront wait invalidation-completed \

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
